info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Settlement Processing API
info.description: The Settlement Processing API enables businesses to efficiently manage settlement workflows by processing specific settlements identified by their settlement ID. This endpoint allows authorized clients to trigger the processing of settlements, facilitating essential financial activities such as reconciliation or dispute resolution. Typical consumers include financial institutions and payment processors that require reliable and swift processing of transactions. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their operational efficiency and improve response times to financial activities.

post.description: This operation allows you to process a settlement identified by a unique resource ID (RES-100045). It performs the necessary actions to complete the settlement process, ensuring that all relevant data is updated accordingly.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate the processing of the specified settlement with ID RES-100045. Ensure that all relevant data fields are populated according to the schema to facilitate a successful operation.

Summary.title: Settlement Summary

grossPayments.description: The total amount of gross payments included in the settlement.

refunds.description: The total amount of refunds processed during the settlement period.

reversals.description: The total amount of reversals applied during the settlement period.

disputes.description: The total amount of disputed transactions during the settlement period.

fees.description: The total amount of fees charged during the settlement period.

taxes.description: The total amount of taxes applied during the settlement period.

reserveHeld.description: The total amount of reserves held for the settlement.

reserveReleased.description: The total amount of reserves released during the settlement.

netSettlement.description: The net amount settled after all adjustments, fees, and taxes.
